# HAKII

> > HAKII is a wearable audio and sports gear brand specializing in innovative open-ear headphones, TWS earbuds, and smart sports accessories with advanced technologies like abTube directional sound and Bluetooth connectivity.

HAKII offers a comprehensive range of wearable audio devices designed for active lifestyles, including patented open-listening headphones, smart headbands with music hats, Bluetooth cycling glasses, and high-performance wireless earbuds. The brand combines cutting-edge audio technology with sports-focused design for athletes and fitness enthusiasts.
